suggestions: Pre-filter a large table as a CTE before the join
Reorder joins to reduce intermediate rows
Convert an IN subquery to a semi-join
reached_sql:
SELECT c.c_last_name,
       c.c_first_name,
       c.c_salutation,
       c.c_preferred_cust_flag,
       dj.ss_ticket_number,
       dj.cnt
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT
           ss.ss_ticket_number,
           ss.ss_customer_sk,
           count(*) OVER (
               PARTITION BY ss.ss_ticket_number, ss.ss_customer_sk
           ) AS cnt
    FROM store_sales AS ss
    JOIN household_demographics AS hd
        ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
       AND (
           hd.hd_buy_potential = '1001-5000'
           OR hd.hd_buy_potential = '5001-10000'
       )
       AND hd.hd_vehicle_count > 0
       AND CASE
               WHEN hd.hd_vehicle_count > 0
               THEN hd.hd_dep_count / hd.hd_vehicle_count
               ELSE NULL
           END > 1
    JOIN date_dim AS dd
        ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
       AND dd.d_dom BETWEEN 1 AND 2
       AND dd.d_year IN (2000, 2000 + 1, 2000 + 2)
    JOIN store AS s
        ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
       AND s.s_county IN (
           'Williamson County',
           'Williamson County',
           'Williamson County',
           'Williamson County'
       )
) AS dj
JOIN customer AS c
    ON dj.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
WHERE dj.cnt BETWEEN 1 AND 5
ORDER BY dj.cnt DESC,
         c.c_last_name ASC
